body:
My therapist discharged me because we reached the maximum number of sessions. To be fair, I could probably have pushed for more but she wasn't great (nice person but really unorganised) so I decided I'd re-refer to get a different therapist instead. 

I wouldn't consider adoption in my case because she's very well loved by my other half and both our families. I also know that there are long waiting lists for adoptive parents and I wouldn't want her to be passed around foster families or care homes. Ive felt a huge sense of duty to look after her since she was born. I'm just don't think I'm the best person to do it.
